Firstly, since $|{-a}| = |a|,$ we can write our expression as

$$
|3z|-5\cdot|4z|.
$$

Then, we distribute the absolute value over the multiplication, and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}|3z|-5\cdot |4z| & = \\ |3|\cdot |z|-5\cdot |4|\cdot |z| & = \\ 3\cdot |z|-5\cdot 4\cdot |z| & = \\ 3\cdot |z|-20\cdot |z| & = \\ 3|z|-20|z| & = \\ -17|z| & \end{aligned}
$$
